folder_html:
LIVE WAVE PERIOD & DIRECTION

How far apart the wave crests are right now (peak period, seconds) with arrows showing which way the waves travel. Long-interval swell (high seconds, purple) carries far more energy than short chop at the same height.

Peak wave period (seconds between crests, as filed by GLWU PERPW): LOWEST 0s dark-blue flat → 2 blue → 3 cyan → 4 green → 5 yellow → 6 orange → 7.5 red → 9 magenta → 10.5 violet → HIGHEST+ 12s dark-purple long swell. Same seconds always show the same color; values above 12s stay dark-purple. Arrows point where the waves are traveling (WVDIR filed direction + 180°). Lake max now: 6.9s, mean 3.5s, mean travel 100° (E).

Units: seconds between crests (arrows show travel direction)
